title: Month 2, Week 4 (Dec 27, 2026 – Jan 2, 2027): Ear/Eye Pathology, Spindle/Round Cell IHC Integration & Month 2 Checkpoint

days.b1:
Retrieval (15m): Spaced recall of Month 1 CNS Embryonal & Glial tumors.
Reading — Ear, Eye & Neck Cysts/Paragangliomas (75m): Curriculum Normal/Surgical Path Objectives — Ear: Cholesteatoma, Middle Ear NET (LMW-CK+, Synaptophysin+, INSM1+, CDX2/SATB2+), Endolymphatic Sac Tumor (VHL, papillary clear cell PAX8+/CAIX+), Jugulotympanic Paraganglioma (SDHB loss = high metastatic risk!, GATA3+, Synaptophysin+, S100+ sustentacular, Keratin-); Neck Cysts: Thyroglossal duct cyst vs. Branchial cleft cyst; Eye: Retinoblastoma (RB1, Flexner-Wintersteiner rosettes, optic nerve/choroidal invasion staging), Uveal Melanoma (GNAQ/GNA11; BAP1 nuclear loss = liver metastasis risk!), & Eyelid Sebaceous Carcinoma (pagetoid spread, AR+, Adipophilin+, Muir-Torre MMR loss).
days.b2:
Spot Slides (15m): 5 slides @ 3m/case (Cholesteatoma, Paraganglioma zellballen, Retinoblastoma, Uveal melanoma, Branchial cleft cyst).
QBank (30m): 20 Ear, Eye & Neck MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Log 4-Domain SOE entry on Head & Neck Paraganglioma (Keratin-, GATA3+, Synaptophysin+, S100+ sustentacular, and mandatory SDHB IHC screening).

days.b1:
Retrieval (15m): Recall Eyelid Sebaceous Carcinoma vs. BCC vs. SCC IHC panel and Retinoblastoma high-risk pathological features (post-laminar optic nerve invasion, massive choroidal invasion ≥3 mm).
Reading — Master IHC & Molecular Integration for Spindle & Round Cell Tumors (75m): Synthesis of translocation surrogate IHCs (STAT6, MUC4, TLE1, SS18-SSX, NKX2.2, BCOR, WT1/ETV4, H3.3 G34W, H3.3 K36M, Brachyury, FOSB, CAMTA1, TFE3, MYOD1, Myogenin, SOX10, H3K27me3, INI1, BRG1, SDHB, NUT, NR4A3/NOR1, Pan-TRK).
days.b2:
Spot Slides (15m): 5 Challenging Spindle/Epithelioid Slides @ 3m/case.
QBank (20m): 20 IHC & Molecular Sarcoma/H&N MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Review all 4 Month 2 One-Pagers in Tab 2 and verify your IHC/Molecular memory triggers.

days.b1: Retrieval (15m): Flash-recall 15 translocation-specific IHC surrogate stains and their exact fusion partners.
days.b2:
Slide Sprint (60m): 12 Timed Slides: 6 Mixed Soft Tissue, Bone & Head/Neck Spot Slides (3m/case) + 6 Salivary (Milan) & Cervical (Bethesda) Cytology Slides (6m/case).
QBank (45m): 25 Mixed Surgical Path & Cyto MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Record a 3-min spoken SOE response on a Parotid Mass FNA diagnosed as Milan Category IVB (SUMP — Basaloid vs. Oncocytic/Clear Cell).

days.b1: Spaced Retrieval & Cross-System Integration (90m): Overlapping entities between Month 1 (CNS) and Month 2 (Soft Tissue/Bone/H&N): Meningeal Solitary Fibrous Tumor (NAB2::STAT6, CNS WHO Gr 1–3 criteria), Skull Base Chordoma vs. Chondrosarcoma, MPNST (H3K27me3 loss) vs. Cellular Schwannoma (SOX10/S100 diffuse+, H3K27me3 retained, p16 retained, subcapsular lymphoid aggregates), Olfactory Neuroblastoma vs. Sinonasal SNUC, & INI1-deficient Rhabdoid tumors.
days.b2: QBank & Slides (30m): 20 Cross-System MCQs + 5 Skull Base / Peripheral Nerve Spot Slides.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Log the Cellular Schwannoma vs. MPNST SOE differential (why cellular schwannoma with mitoses/focal necrosis is still benign!).

days.b1: Retrieval (15m): Blank-sheet recall of Cellular Schwannoma vs. MPNST vs. Monophasic Synovial Sarcoma vs. Spindle Cell Melanoma.
days.b2:
QBank Sprint (60m): 30 Timed MCQs (15 Mixed Month 1 & 2 + 15 2015–2023 Trainee Recalls on Head/Neck, Salivary, Soft Tissue & Bone).
Deep Review (45m): Dissect every recall item.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Update your 4-Domain SOE Log with all year-end recall pearls.

days.b2: (Optional) 30m light review of Month 2 SOE Log before tomorrow's Checkpoint.

days.b1: Launch Month 3 Preview — Hematopathology [Conf: 2/5] & Dermatopathology [Conf: 2/5] (2.0h): SCFHS Curriculum Hematopathology Objectives — Normal Lymph Node Architecture & Reactive Patterns (Follicular hyperplasia vs. Follicular lymphoma, Paracortical/viral, Rosai-Dorfman, Castleman, Kikuchi, Kimura, Toxoplasma, Cat-scratch).
days.b2:
Month 2 Cumulative Checkpoint Exam (2.0h):
• 60 Timed MCQs (70m): Soft Tissue & Bone (45%), Head & Neck/Salivary (30%), Cervical/Salivary Cyto (10%), Month 1 CNS/Molecular/QC Spaced Retrieval (15%).
• 20 Timed Spot Slides (50m): 8 Soft Tissue/Bone + 6 Head & Neck/Salivary + 3 CNS + 3 Cyto.
days.b3: Month 2 Audit (30m): Score Month 2 Checkpoint, update Soft Tissue/Bone & Head/Neck Confidence Sliders, click Push, and switch Month dropdown to 3 - Jan 2027.
